fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: The index seeks to offer exposure to market volatility through publicly traded futures markets and is designed to measure the implied volatility of the S&P 500 over 30 days in the future.

news.paragraph: UVXY, an ETF designed to track volatility, is the subject of recent articles discussing intraday trading strategies and its role in uncertain market conditions. While one article suggests its utility for short-term plays, another from March cautions that "good things do not last" for leveraged volatility products. The ETF is generally considered a tool for hedging or short-term speculation rather than a long-term investment.
